data_origin: Measured Kubernetes house-price service with Locust and Prometheus. Historical calibration rows used HPA-selected replicas; the added 450m CPU calibration used two fixed replicas on an Azure development segment.

heldout_validation.method: 80/20 GroupShuffleSplit by measurement run; explicitly identified calibration runs remain in one group, and legacy sources retain contiguous triplet grouping.

paper_model_comparison.method: random 80/20 holdout; MinMax scaling fitted on train split

paper_selection_note: The published method compares LR, RDF, SVR, XGB, MLP, and DTR after 80/20 normalized holdout evaluation. This implementation evaluates the available families on this project's measured table and fits DTR for every baseline/novelty arm, following the paper's reported choice.
limitations: This is measured calibration data from the local Minikube benchmark service, not production Kubernetes traces.
The offline trace ablation still estimates latency and SLO with its simulator; using this DTR does not make those simulated outcomes live measurements.
The benchmark has one application and a limited CPU/request-rate envelope; extrapolation outside the recorded range is unvalidated.
